posts.alt: Poway backyard sunken fire lounge with a circular fire pit, board-formed concrete seating and olive trees against chaparral hills at dusk
posts.hook: Drop the seating below grade and the whole yard wraps around the fire.
posts.caption:
There's a reason a sunken lounge feels different: drop the seating below grade and the yard closes in around the fire like a room.

Board-formed concrete benches, a clean circular burner, and enough space to seat everyone who shows up.

The selections:
• Warming Trends circular fire pit
• board-formed concrete seat walls
• Belgard Dimensions pavers
• olive trees
• FX Luminaire lighting

Want a fire lounge the whole yard wraps around? DM “DESIGN”.

posts.alt: Rancho Santa Fe estate backyard with a large pool, raised spa and glass-tile spillway on a travertine deck with rolling hills
posts.hook: An estate lot deserves a pool that answers to it.
posts.caption:
On an estate lot, the pool sets the scale for everything else — so it's the first line we draw, not the last.

A clean rectangle, a raised spa spilling into it, a wide travertine deck to entertain from, all sited to the hills beyond.

The selections:
• silver travertine deck
• glass-tile spa spillway
• Baja tanning shelf
• olive trees
• FX Luminaire lighting

Have the lot for a pool like this? DM “DESIGN”.
posts.geotag: Rancho Santa Fe, San Diego, CA

posts.alt: Aerial view of a Poway entertainment backyard with a paver patio, grill island, sunken fire lounge and turf lawn against chaparral hills
posts.hook: Everything a Saturday needs, laid out from above.
posts.caption:
From the air you can read the plan: a place to cook, a place to gather at the fire, and open turf between them so it never feels like a parking lot.

Zones sized for how the family actually hosts, connected by clean sight lines. Get the plan right and everything after is just execution.

The selections:
• Belgard paver patio
• built-in grill island
• sunken fire lounge
• SYNLawn turf
• olive & ornamental grasses

Want the plan before the pavers? DM “DESIGN”.

posts.alt: Fairbanks Ranch estate backyard outdoor living room with a grand Eldorado Stone fireplace, linen sofas and an ipe wood ceiling at golden hour
posts.hook: An outdoor room doesn't need walls. It needs a hearth.
posts.caption:
An outdoor room doesn't need walls. It needs a hearth.

Stone carried up to the ceiling, deep seating pulled in close, and a wood ceiling overhead to make it feel like the house simply kept going. The most-used room on the property has no doors.

The selections:
• Eldorado Stone veneer fireplace
• ipe wood ceiling
• travertine floor
• deep linen seating
• mature olive trees

Want a room like this without a roof? DM “DESIGN”.

posts.alt: Refined Del Mar coastal-contemporary covered patio with an ipe ceiling, porcelain pavers, a linear water feature and a sculptural olive tree
posts.hook: We come back at month ten. On our own.
posts.caption:
Anyone can make a space look good on handover day. The real question is whether it still looks like this two summers later.

That's why every project includes The 10-Month Walk-Through — we come back, on our own, and go over the whole space with a fine-toothed comb before the first year is out. Settling, grout, drainage, finishes. We'd rather catch it than have you find it.

The selections:
• Belgard Porcelain pavers
• ipe wood ceiling
• linear water feature
• FX Luminaire lighting
• sculptural olive tree

Want a firm that's still around at month ten? DM “DESIGN”.
